$comment: Provider-neutral (RC97): no if/then/oneOf, which vendor strict modes reject. The Worker's zod parse (src/prompts/templates.ts parseReadingOutput) also requires, when classification is none, a non-empty title, overview and synthesis, one non-empty interpretation per drawn card with its ids echoed, and the spread's number of non-empty reflection prompts.

classification.description: Decided first. "none" = write the reading; any other value = refusal, every other string empty.

title.description: Two to seven words. Non-empty unless declined.

overview.description: Two or three sentences. Non-empty unless declined.

cards.description: One entry per drawn card, in input order. Empty only when declined.

synthesis.description: How the cards connect, ending on one concrete step. Non-empty unless declined.

reflectionPrompts.description: Exactly the number given in <length>, open questions. [""] when declined.
